mechanisms.title: Credit Management
mechanisms.memory_hook: The order can be commercially correct and still not be releasable.
controls: delivery/billing progression depending on check design
failure_proof: unexpected block → BP risk class/check rule + credit segment + limit/exposure + failed check step
high-risk order passes → prove the actual check rule and assigned steps

mechanisms.title: Billing
mechanisms.memory_hook: Billing starts earlier than VF04: item category already decided what can become billable.
debug_paths: nothing due → billing relevance + completion/status + block/date + copy-control eligibility
unexpected split → split analysis + header/partner field comparison
wrong invoice price → copy-control pricing type before pricing master data
